{{Top|leg}}
The [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] '''breaching grenade''' was an explosive weapon used to blow open sealed doors from a distance, rather than expose a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] to enemy return-fire by placing a charge directly on the surface to be breached. The breaching grenade came as a mountable attachment to easily turn any standard [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], such as the [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17]], into a [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]]. [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commando]] [[Darman Skirata|RC-1136]] used a Merr-Sonn breaching grenade to allow [[Omega Squad|Omega]] and [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta]] squads to enter a civilian home in [[Hadde]] to locate rebels responsible for launching a missile at the Republic base from within the city.
